entities.summary: Victoria Vanessa "Vicky" Mboko is a Canadian professional tennis player. She has a career-high WTA singles ranking of world No. 9 and a doubles ranking of No. 165, with the former achieved on March 16, 2026. She is the current Canadian No. 1 in women's singles.
